title: E0070: Remote file inclusion
plain_english: Using user-controlled input to determine which file to include or require can allow an attacker to load and execute remote or local files on the server.
why_matters: Remote file inclusion (RFI) and local file inclusion (LFI) can allow attackers to: - Include and execute PHP code from remote servers - Read sensitive local files - Compromise the server
what_it_checks: `include`, `require`, `include_once`, and `require_once` where the path is built from user-controlled input
`file_get_contents()`, `readfile()`, and `fopen()` with user-controlled file paths from remote sources
